lines: Bhavya Kapoor is an Investor Selling Shareholder with up to ₹0.61 crore in proceeds if all offered shares are sold.
Their retained stake is an estimated ₹1.42 crore at offer price; the gain is up to ₹0.45 crore before expenses and taxes.
The trigger is recent: shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, though these are shares, not cash.
Money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago), so the call is worth making now; name verified in seller table, holdings from one section only.
